instruction: Candid documentary photograph, eye-level medium shot. Inside a judo dojo, the bearded young man in the white judo gi (R4) and the young woman in the blue judo gi (R1) jog forward side-by-side. The bearded young man (R4) looks slightly to his left while running, while the young woman (R1) looks straight ahead. The young man in the white judo gi (R2) is partially visible jogging directly behind them. Soft natural light enters from a window in the background, illuminating the runners as they warm up.
